title: Dreams of Aether
description:
ABOUT:Dreams of Aether is a short and sweet cluster of fast-paced, seconds-long microgames! Starring characters from all over Aether, from legendary figures like Zetterburn and Orcane, to the humble Pyrewing and Florpian. Punch, Flap, and Swing your way through the dubiously-canon story, and see how far you can get in endless modes!

Absa, the Storm Architect from the far-off Tempest Peak, finds herself trapped in an eternal dream world. And things are getting WEIRD! Why can't she wake up? What's with all of these out-of-body experiences? What's this piñata doing here? Why am I asking YOU all these questions?

FEATURES:• 5 stages of Aether-flavored microgames!

• Go for high scores in endless modes of every stage!

• A new original soundtrack directed by flashygoodness!

• A smattering of unique artstyles!

• Laugh at the funny animals interacting! please

• THE LORE

• Absa! She's in this one! It's not a fakeout!

• Dan Fornace-approved, i think?
description_short: A collection of dozens of Aether-flavored microgames! Dive into the Dreams of Aether, where everyone is trapped in a never-ending nightmare! Meet some of the strangest characters Aether has to offer!
